rules: This file is audit authority input, not Current lexical content.
Mechanical readback may inspect source-facing/reverse Relation Owner views and anchor lifecycle only.
Mechanical readback must not infer semantic equivalence, approve a contrast, invent meanings, or mutate learner state.
A source-facing relation candidate is not a semantic PASS until Chat reviews its boundary or accepts a calibrated bulk class.

targets.approved_target: heir / air — homophone; heir = inheritor, air = atmosphere
high / highly — physical/level high vs degree adverb highly; fly high vs highly likely
hire / rent — temporary use/employment vs rental, with dialect/register caveat
hope / wish — realistic/possible expectation vs desire, unreal/regret/change; syntax differs
hole / whole — homophone; opening vs entire
homogeneous / heterogeneous — same-kind/consistent vs mixed/different kinds
horse / hoarse — homophone; animal vs rough voice
hour / our — homophone in standard pronunciation
human / humane — of humans/human nature vs compassionate/kind treatment
house noun /haʊs/ vs verb /haʊz/
hundred / hundreds of — exact two hundred (no plural -s) vs indefinite hundreds of
hypothesis / theory — testable proposed explanation vs broader explanatory framework; theory is not merely a guess
idle / idol — sound/form confusable; inactive vs admired person/object
if / whether — overlap in indirect yes/no questions; whether preferred/required with alternatives, after prepositions, before infinitives, etc.
ill / sick — both unwell but distribution/register differs; concise and dialect-aware
illuminate / illustrate — clarify/light up vs explain/show with examples or pictures
illusion / allusion — false perception/appearance vs indirect reference
illusion / delusion — misleading perception/appearance vs persistent false belief; not interchangeable
imaginary / imaginative — unreal vs creative
immediate / instant — no delay/direct/nearest vs occurring in an instant/very rapid
impact / influence — often strong/noticeable effect vs broader, often gradual/indirect influence
impatient / eager — restless at delay vs positive keenness
import / export — direction into vs out of a country/system
import noun vs verb stress
incidence / prevalence — new events/cases over a period vs all existing cases at a time/period
incidence / incident — rate/occurrence concept vs a particular event
incident / accident / event — noteworthy occurrence vs unintended mishap vs broad event
include / contain / comprise — member-listing vs holding-within vs whole-to-parts composition
inclusive / exclusive — including stated limits/groups vs excluding/restricted
increase noun vs verb stress
incredible / incredulous — hard to believe/amazing vs a person being unwilling/unable to believe
independent / dependent — independent of vs dependent on
industrial / industrious — relating to industry vs hardworking/diligent
infectious / contagious — infection-caused/capable of spread vs communicable by transmission/contact; overlap, not absolute
inhale / exhale — breathe in vs breathe out
inhibit / prohibit — restrain/reduce vs formally forbid
injure / hurt / wound — formal physical harm vs broad physical/emotional hurt vs injury commonly caused by weapon/cut
innovation / invention — introduction/application/improvement of new ideas/methods vs creation of something new
institute / institution — organization/verb establish vs established organization/system/custom
insult noun vs verb stress
intelligent / intelligible — smart vs understandable
intense / intensive — very strong in degree vs concentrated/thorough/resource-heavy
interest / interested / interesting — noun/verb state or stake vs experiencer adjective vs stimulus adjective
intercourse / interaction — modern ordinary intercourse usually sexual; social intercourse formal/old-fashioned; interaction neutral
instance / instant — example/case vs moment/immediate
